note: Cluster, clearance, degree and slot-enumeration conventions agree. R_D has no standalone definition in [L]; it is the expression inside the `remainder` fields of the two OPE statements, with the coefficients as fields of the Reader or hierarchy.

structure SeparatedOPE : Prop where
  coefficient (I : Type) [Fintype I] (d : I → ℕ) (a : Labels S d) (M η ε : ℝ) :
    0 ≤ M → 0 < η → 0 < ε → ∀ (j : ℕ) (i : Q.channels j), ∀ᶠ r : ℝ in 𝓝[>] 0,
      ∀ (x : I → E4) (o : E4), WithinRoom r M η x o →
        ‖Q.coef j i x a o‖ ≤ r ^ ((j : ℝ) - weight d - ε)
  remainder {I J : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype J] {d : I → ℕ} {e : J → ℕ}
      (a : Labels S d) (b : Labels S e) {M η c ε : ℝ}
      (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hη : 0 < η) (hc : 0 < c) (hε : 0 < ε) (D : ℕ) :
    ∀ᶠ r : ℝ in 𝓝[>] 0, ∀ (x : I → E4) (o : E4) (y : J → E4),
      WithinRoom r M η x o → ClearOf o y c → ∀ s : Viewers F,
      ‖whole (spectator F s) x a y b -
        ∑ j : Fin (D + 1), ∑ i : Q.channels j.val, Q.coef j.val i x a o *
          whole (spectator F s) (sole o)
            (sole (Q.actor j.val i) : Labels S (fun _ : Unit => j.val)) y b‖
        ≤ r ^ ((D : ℝ) + 1 - weight d - ε)

  profiles (I J : Type) [Fintype I] [Fintype J] (d : I → ℕ) (e : J → ℕ)
      (a : Labels S d) (b : Labels S e) (M η c ε : ℝ) :
    0 ≤ M → 0 < η → 0 < c → 0 < ε → ∀ (D : ℕ) (K : Type) [MeasurableSpace K] (B : ℝ),
      ∀ᶠ r : ℝ in 𝓝[>] 0, ∀ (μ : Measure K) (w : K → ℂ) (z : K → Loc I J),
        AEMeasurable z μ → Integrable w μ → (∫ i, ‖w i‖ ∂μ) ≤ B →
        (∀ᵐ i ∂μ, w i ≠ 0 → z i ∈ FitsOn I J M η c r) →
        (∀ χ : K → F.α.space.X, AEMeasurable χ μ →
          JointEstimate F Q D a b (B * r ^ ((D : ℝ) + 1 - weight d - ε)) μ w z (some ∘ χ)) ∧
        JointEstimate F Q D a b (B * r ^ ((D : ℝ) + 1 - weight d - ε)) μ w z (fun _ => none)

def Clear {J : Type} (o : Spacetime) (y : J → Spacetime) (c : ℝ) : Prop :=
  (∀ i, c ≤ ‖o - y i‖) ∧ (∀ i j, i ≠ j → c ≤ ‖y i - y j‖)

structure OperatorProductExpansion : Prop where
  coefficients {I : Type} [Fintype I] (a : I → T.Tag) (M η ε : ℝ) :
    0 ≤ M → 0 < η → 0 < ε → ∀ j (i : T.Channel j), ∀ᶠ r : ℝ in 𝓝[>] 0,
    ∀ x o, Within r M η x o → ‖T.coefficient a j i x o‖ ≤ r ^ ((j:ℝ) - T.weight a - ε)
  remainder {I J : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype J] (a : I → T.Tag) (b : J → T.Tag)
      (M η c ε : ℝ) : 0 ≤ M → 0 < η → 0 < c → 0 < ε → ∀ D : ℕ,
      ∀ᶠ r : ℝ in 𝓝[>] 0, ∀ x o y, Within r M η x o → Clear o y c → ∀ s,
      ‖T.grouped s a x b y -
        ∑ j : Fin (D+1), ∑ i : T.Channel j.val, T.coefficient a j.val i x o *
          T.grouped s (fun _ : Unit => ⟨j.val,T.actor j.val i⟩) (fun _ => o) b y‖
        ≤ r ^ ((D:ℝ) + 1 - T.weight a - ε)

def Within {I : Type} (r M η : ℝ) (x : I → Spacetime) (o : Spacetime) : Prop :=
  (∀ i, ‖x i - o‖ ≤ M*r) ∧ (∀ i j, i ≠ j → η*r ≤ ‖x i - x j‖)

def grouped {I J : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype J] (s : Option T.Character)
    (a : I → T.Tag) (x : I → Spacetime) (b : J → T.Tag) (y : J → Spacetime) : ℂ :=
  let slots := (Fintype.equivFin (I ⊕ J)).symm
  T.correlation s ((Sum.elim a b) ∘ slots) (WithLp.toLp 2 ((Sum.elim x y) ∘ slots))
def weight {I : Type} [Fintype I] (a : I → T.Tag) : ℝ := ∑ i, ((a i).1 : ℝ)
